name: AgentCourt
requiredCapabilities: optional-comitempty filing commitment (no strict hash format gate)
note: Two deploy-compatibility gates are enforced: (1) contract must expose court_info.payout_mode=evm-direct for synchronous payout atomicity; (2) filing uses optional client-side commitments — deployments built from a previous source with a strict _valid_commitment format gate will fail file_dispute whenever the browser cannot compute a hash (CORS/local evidence URLs) and MUST be replaced.
